stages.title: Semi-basement ICF
stages.desc: Nudura ICF semi-basement on its raft: 8in XR35 retaining ring to the terrace drop, 6in XR35 spine wall, seven courses to +0.00, with the two internal door openings.

stages.title: Ground-floor slab
stages.desc: The 300 mm ground-floor slab bearing on the semi-basement walls, indicative.

stages.title: Ground-floor ICF
stages.desc: Nudura 6in XR35 ground-floor walls with the fifteen openings, cut to the drawn parapets: +3.80 to the bedroom bar, +4.80 at the west wall of the living bar falling over 5.24 m to +3.80.

stages.title: Roofs and pool
stages.desc: The indicative roof slabs over both bars and the 6in Standard pool shell, 6.0 x 3.0 x 2.0 m deep, on its base.
